prompt:
Create EXACTLY TWELVE COMPLETE pixel-art sprites of Lucius Normal doing SwordThrust. Reference1 PRIMARY canonical six-pose sword sheet defines exact sword, two-hand axial thrust, small blue tip spark, mature compact figure and recovery. Reference2 COMPLETE idle sheet defines identity/costume and precise directional views. Reference3 COMPLETE E/SE attacks supports the same sword construction/grip/low guard, not horizontal choreography. NEW atlas, requested2048x2048 square, THREE equally spaced columns and FOUR rows. Full characters and entire sword/effects with ample transparent margins, never overlap or crop. About400px hair-to-supporting-sole figure height within each512px row, keep body size constant. Not a collage of anatomy.
ROW1 NORTH: directly BACK, head back and coat back visible, no face, thrust AWAY toward IMAGE UP with strong true depth foreshortening, not sidewise. ROW2 NORTHEAST: three-quarter BACK, facing IMAGE UPPER RIGHT, thrust toward upper-right; back of coat visible, any visible nose points RIGHT. ROW3 EAST: strict RIGHT-facing PROFILE, thrust directly IMAGE RIGHT, no frontal turn. ROW4 SOUTHEAST: three-quarter FRONT facing IMAGE LOWER RIGHT, face and blue eyes visible, thrust toward lower-right with depth. Exact drawn views, no mirror/flat rotation. Use idle row2col1=N,row2col2=NE,row2col3=E,row2col4=SE as view authority. Do not make all four rows same profile.
Each row THREE coherent distinct consecutive phases LEFT TO RIGHT. COL1 STARTUP: point withdrawn close to flank/chest, blade aligned along thrust direction, BOTH HANDS grasping SAME handle, bent elbows, torso loaded slightly on back leg, feet planted in stable combat base. NO sword raised overhead, no over-shoulder swing. COL2 ACTIVE: direct AXIAL two-handed thrust along that row direction, both arms and blade aligned toward target, front knee flexed, rear leg extended, controlled torso rotation/lean; blade tip SMALL tight BLUE-white impact sparkle only, NO sweeping arc, slash crescent or ground smash. COL3 RECOVERY: withdraw blade coherently back and settle into canonical low diagonal guard, same two hands on one handle, tip safely low and clear of boots, serious closed-mouth face. Return from same thrust rather than a disconnected idle pose.
ROOT STABILITY REQUIRED: EACH ROW same pelvis/root axis in ALL THREE columns and SAME support-floor baseline. Boots keep same ground-support positions/stance width for all three phases; front knee can flex and rear leg extend by ankle/knee articulation but do NOT step or lunge whole body through canvas. No root translation, no camera movement or scale changes; only coherent in-place upper-body/arm/sword articulation. Body controller alone moves character later. Do not change hair/head height dramatically. Keep weapon fully visible even in fully extended thrust; increase transparent horizontal spacing, not shrink body. No duplicated body or repeated static arm pose presented as action.
IDENTITY LOCK: exact compact mature anatomy and serious adult face of approved references, silver/lavender short compact layered hair same volume/length, open BLUE eyes when visible, clean original pale skin, closed mouth; black/navy long gothic coat, torn cobalt blue lower tails and ribbons, canonical silver buckle straps/chains/pendants/gloves/heavy boots. Exact SINGLE broad steel sword, dark centre with bright silver bevel, long dark two-hand grip/guard and blue tie. Held in both hands throughout; NO second sword/hilt/scabbard on back. Preserve clothes and equipment anatomy together in every figure. Sharp native pixel clusters, coherent upper-left light, no blur or painterly texture, no transformation. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT RGBA background with no checkerboard, floor, shadow, gradient, fog, labels, grid, text, UI. Minor natural pose differences acceptable; priority complete coherent directional thrust with planted fixed root.
